description: Remembers the page as it is now, or, if it already has a baseline for this URL, returns the regions that moved since then, outlined on the newer frame. This is the loop to use when editing: call it once before your change, make the change, then call it again. Two screenshots answer "did it land" badly, because the eye has to hunt and most of the frame is identical. The baseline is per URL and is forgotten when the browser idles, which is deliberate: one that outlived the session would quietly compare against yesterday.

reset.description: Replace the baseline with the current page instead of comparing.

name: diff_capture
title: What changed since last time
